name: go-static-embedded-binary
body: kalide must be written in Go and ship as a single self-contained static binary per supported target — Apple silicon macOS (darwin/arm64) and Windows x64 (windows/amd64), plus Windows ARM (windows/arm64) only when a GitHub-hosted native runner is available; never Intel macOS or Linux — with no external runtime or network dependency at run time. Only the core of the tool is embedded via Go embed: the vendored reveal.js runtime, the unbranded core page shells (deck, error, gallery) and the minimal `kalide init` seed scaffold; the core must remain unbranded. Templates, themes, fonts, logos and other media must never be embedded; they are read from the project's `templates/` directory (see global.constraint.no-embedded-template-assets).
